misfits.why: A full SQLite execution engine (busy-retry-on-SQLITE_BUSY loop, named-parameter binding, corruption detection, slow-query logging) declared and implemented in a generic string-utility header/source, while SQResult, SQValue, and SQliteParameter already live in this same directory as their own dedicated units
misfits.suggested_home: A dedicated SQLite-execution unit alongside SQResult/SQValue/SQliteParameter

misfits.why: A complete HTTP wire-format grammar (headers, chunked transfer-encoding, cookie folding, URI parsing) sitting in the generic utility file even though this directory already has a dedicated SHTTPSManager for HTTP transactions
misfits.suggested_home: SHTTPSManager or a new SHTTPMessage unit

misfits.why: Self-contained mbedtls wrappers with no dependency on anything else in this file
Raw socket/poll primitives whose only real caller is STCPManager, the dedicated socket-management class that already lives in this same directory
Gzip compression, unrelated to the string/HTTP/SQL utilities around it; small and self-contained

A complete alternate logging transport with its own per-socket locking, sitting beside unrelated HTTP/JSON/SQL/crypto code, even though SLog.cpp already exists in this directory as the dedicated logging-support unit

Leading-underscore naming signals 'file-private' but none are declared static or placed in an anonymous namespace, so they have external linkage and could collide with an identically-named symbol in another translation unit

name_fit.note: libstuff openly advertises itself as a catch-all, and libstuff/ is the shared-utility directory, so it fits its own name

location_fit.note: Established repo pattern is to carve cohesive slices out of libstuff into their own units (SQResult, SData, STCPManager, SHTTPSManager, SSignal, SLog, STime already did); several slices that fit that pattern (SQL execution, crypto, HTTP wire format) still remain

naming_quality.note: Consistent 'S' prefix on public symbols; fd_map is the one lowercase unprefixed typedef; file-local helper functions use a leading underscore for 'private' but lack real internal linkage
